name: Glass email send
oneLiner: a compose window on glass: the recipient chip pops, the subject types and the body writes itself behind a caret, a cursor presses Send, the window winds up and flies off, and a Message sent toast lands green in its place with the tick drawing
say: when the speaker says they sent it or the AI wrote and sent the email ('it wrote the email and hit send', 'I sent the pitch that night'): the body writes as they describe it, the window flies off and the green Sent toast lands on 'sent'
